text:
Maya: CI e2e on main is red — session-store (redis-mock) container keeps exiting with bind error.
Adrian: Any logs? could be port collision on 6379/6380 from parallel runners.
Maya: Docker logs from the runner:
```bash
docker: Error response from daemon: Conflict. The container name "/session-redis" is already in use by container "7f3c..."
2026-03-17T09:12:34Z redis-mock | Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use 0.0.0.0:6379
```
ci-bot: Job e2e-main-runner #412 failed — tests: session_expiry_test, auth_flow_test
Kai: This smells like leftover containers not being cleaned between parallel matrix runs. Try rerun with CLEAN_WORKSPACE=1 or set --tmpfs for /var/lib/docker.
Samira: Also note redis-mock image was bumped yesterday (tag: latest -> v1.3.0). If it's a change, pin to v1.2.4 to see if it goes away.
Maya: Kicking a manual rerun with CLEAN_WORKSPACE=1 now: `./ci/run-e2e --suite=auth --env=CLEAN_WORKSPACE=1`
Adrian: I'll peek at runner-12 (where the failure happened) — might need to restart docker-engine if orphaned containers are stuck.
Kai: If rerun flakes, can someone collect `docker ps -a` + `ss -ltnp` from the runner so we can bisect.
Maya: Rerun queued (build 1798765450).
ci-bot: Rerun started for job e2e-main-runner #412 (build 1798765450)
Maya: Rerun results: session_expiry_test passed, auth_flow_test still failed once with same bind error.
Samira: Opening a tracker: ENGINFRA-3212 to pin redis-mock and add cleanup step in CI.
Adrian: I restarted docker-engine on runner-12 and cleared dangling containers — will monitor.
Kai: Long term: add `--rm` and deterministic network names in docker-compose to avoid name collisions in parallel jobs.
Maya: Thanks all. Short action list I will follow up on:
- PR to pin redis-mock -> v1.2.4
- Add CI pre-step to kill any container named session-redis
- Add debug logs to failing test so we can capture runner state next time
Link to tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGINFRA-3212
Maya: Closing thread — tests stabilized after runner restart + pin. :white_check_mark:
